pagination.nextURL: ={{ (()=>{if(!$response?.headers)return 'https://api.zotero.org/users/' + $('Collection settings').first().json.userId + '/collections/' + $('Collection settings').first().json.collectionKey + '/items?v=3&limit=100';const h=$response.headers.link||'';const m=h.match(/<([^>]+)>;\s*rel="next"/);if(!m)return 'https://api.zotero.org/';if(!m[1].startsWith('https://api.zotero.org/'))throw Error('Invalid next link');return m[1]})() }}
pagination.completeExpression: ={{ (()=>{if(!$response?.headers)return false;if(!Array.isArray($response.body))throw Error('Invalid Zotero page');const h=$response.headers.link||'';if($pageCount>=100&&/rel="next"/.test(h))throw Error('Too many Zotero pages');return !/rel="next"/.test(h)})() }}
